messages:
elena: Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A. Quick capture: wins we heard — fast pilot migrations, clear migration playbooks, and transparent token billing. Losses — KMS/HSM hookup delays, unclear p99 promises in demos, and a few domain-specific model regressions. Capturing Qs + owners below.

marcus: From GTM: high ROI fixes = KMS onboarding docs + a concise SLA menu AEs can show mid-demo. We need two sales-ready bullets for each recent lost deal: what failed and the specific mitigation.

divya: Product ask: can CS/AE share 3 anonymized lost-deal notes? We want concrete language for the one-pager and a simple "what to expect" card for AEs.

sam: Legal/security note: KMS/HSM timelines vary by provider; I can draft acceptable wording for the AE card but we should avoid hard SLA numbers until engineering confirms p99 bounds. I'll own SLA packaging + legal loop.

nico: Eng: model regressions mostly reproduce with a small eval set. Short-term plan: (1) a fallback stable model family for sensitive workloads, (2) KV eviction metrics and alerting. Small squad could deliver a canary + dashboard in ~3 weeks. I can own the canary.

elena: Leadership Qs: who owns (A) SLA menu & legal signoff, (B) migration one-pager + AE card, (C) fallback model canary + KV metrics? Please @ owners so we can track action items.

sam: I will own (A) SLA packaging and coordinate legal/security.

divya: I'll lead (B) with help from CS/marketing for wording. @marcus can you get the lost-deal notes to Divya?

nico: Confirming I own (C). Will post a minimal canary checklist with gate metrics (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token-cost delta).

marcus: I'll redact and post 3 lost-deal summaries by EOD tomorrow and add two win examples with migration steps. Also drafting a template: "What was missing" + "What we can offer next quarter" for AEs.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-4012: "All-hands follow-up - SLA menu, migration playbook, fallback canary" assigned to sam,nico,divya.

elena: Action summary: sam (SLA + legal), divya/marcus (one-pager + lost-deals), nico (canary + metrics), elena (compile evals + runbook). Proposed 20m sync Friday 9:30am. React with :thumbsup: to confirm or suggest another time.
